name: 白水阿弥陀堂
checkpoints: THREE front bays and three bays deep, one pyramidal hogyo roof with a small jewel at the apex.
Wood-shingle roof, open timber veranda and short central stairs; aged wooden lattice doors on the front, board walls on other sides.
Remove the modern outer enclosure, stone lantern, trees and signs.
